truths.truth: Faceplate spec states the trace rule
truths.evidence: docs/spec/faceplate.md:93 says: 'The trace (its line, the filled area under it and its slower-falling shadow) shows under the Trace style only; under every other style, whatever the color suite, the spectrum draws no trace ... (Ridges shows no dB grid lines or dB scale labels).'

truths.truth: Owner's eyes: trace visible under Trace only
truths.evidence: The SUMMARY Deviations section quotes the owner's verdict at the hand-back URL: 'y'know what, that's my mistake... Fade does get a trace. the rest pass.' So AC7 as written ('under ... Fade ... no trace line, fill or shadow is visible') was not met. The owner ruled against the Fade half of the requirement. The code withholds the SVG trace under Fade (sourcepaint.js:74, :326-327; tests ok 942-944). The fx canvas still strokes its own Fade trace (spectrumfx.js:3, :126, :323). The reply does not name the second color suite AC7 requires besides Borealis.
